q: My string-out is forty minutes long, is that normal?
a: String-outs get long; trim obvious waste as you go so comparing takes on the timeline stays quick. Build them with Automate to Sequence… (`clip.automateToSequence`) from the scene's subclips.

q: Why not just keep editing one sequence and rely on undo?
a: Auto-saves and the journal cover crashes; versions cover "the old one was better". Duplicate the sequence (`edit.duplicate` in the Project panel) before big changes and date the copies so they don't pile up unnamed.

q: Can B-roll ever hurt an interview edit?
a: Yes, when it only decorates: unrelated pictures feel like filler. The voice carries the story and the pictures should show what the speaker talks about.

q: My vlog jump cuts feel nervous, what helps?
a: Too many identical jumps feel nervous: vary them with punch-ins (Motion ▸ Scale about 110–120 % on every other cut) and B-roll over some of the cuts.
